lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Honey, have you seen Jackal?
No, why?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I've got a bone to pick with her.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: She made a mess of my closet,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: and I think

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: she snagged some of my favorite clothes.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: My vanity is in shambles as well.
Sounds like she's taken an interest in her appearance.
Maybe she hit puberty?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Your guess is as good as mine.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Actually, now that I think about it...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: you said something about how she ought to dress up more!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: At least I think you did.
I did?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm almost positive.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Did you and Jackal go off and have fun together?
Yes.
No.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Well, my room is a disaster zone,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: and I can't exactly say

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm over the moon,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: but at least you're happy.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Considering the state that my room is in,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I was at least hoping you'd gotten some fun out of all this.
Sorry :/

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Don't be.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Thinking things through isn't exactly Jackal's forte.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I know you were merely making an innocent remark.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Anyway, what should I do?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I was saving those clothes for an important occasion.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I've never even worn them before,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: not once.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I guess I can't show you now :(
What kind of occasion?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Like...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: our anniversary,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: or your birthday.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Well

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: what's happened has happened.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Now you need to choose something for me to wear!
Me?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I wanted to pick an outfit for you anyway, so

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: it makes sense if you're the one to choose it.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: And that includes all the lingerie ;)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe! Just message me whenever you have some time.
